items.headline: Similarity as Reward Alignment: Robust and Versatile Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
items.summary:
arXiv:2506.12529v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Preference-based Reinforcement Learning (PbRL) entails a variety of approaches for aligning models with human intent to alleviate the burden of reward engineering. items.headline: MM-IssueLoc: A Controlled Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Evidence in Multimodal Repository-Level Issue Localization
items.summary:
arXiv:2607.15205v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Real repository issues routinely include visual evidence such as screenshots, error dialogs, rendered UI states, and logs, yet repository-level issue localization is evaluated mostly as a text-only task.
